details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:85-195 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: INLINE_CODE_RE only strips single-backtick spans, so double-backtick GFM code spans can leave auto-close keywords visible to the scanner.
  WHY: Both reviewers reported that valid double-backtick spans are only partially masked, which lets AUTO_CLOSE_RE match text that should have stayed inside code.
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:183 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Closing-fence detection requires the closing fence to be exactly the same length as the opener.
  WHY: With a shorter valid closing fence, the parser keeps treating the rest of the PR body as code and skips later auto-close keywords.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3858-3863 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The implement pre-flight lints only the PR body, not the PR title.
  WHY: The required check validates the squash-merge artifact (title + body), so a future title-template change could bypass pre-flight even though the required check would catch it later.
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:241-261 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When `label_lookup()` returns `None`, that `None` is cached and reused for later references to the same issue in the same run.
  WHY: With `fail_open_on_lookup_error=False`, subsequent references never retry and every reference turns into a lookup_error.
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:196-208 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Fenced code block detection fails when the closing fence is shorter than the opening fence.
  WHY: A 4-backtick opener closed with 3 backticks leaves the remainder of the PR body treated as code, so later violations are silently ignored.
- scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:158-183 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The label lookup cache stores `None` from transient failures and reuses it for subsequent references to the same issue within the same run.
  WHY: A temporary network error on the first reference suppresses violation detection for later references instead of retrying or failing closed.
- scripts/lint_plan_archival_completeness.py:135-142 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_has_descope_section_content` returns true for any non-empty line after the heading, even placeholder text.
  WHY: The archival lint can be satisfied by a de-scoped section that does not actually enumerate any de-scoped phases.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8595-8627 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The state-file update lacks file locking.
  WHY: Concurrent poll ticks can race and overwrite each other's dedup state, which can lead to duplicate Telegram alerts.
- scripts/check_integration_pr_readiness.py:59-68 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_fetch_issue` collapses network errors, rate limits, 404s, and auth failures into the same `None` result.
  WHY: The caller cannot distinguish a missing issue from a GitHub outage, so required status checks lose actionable error information.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
